info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Textile Racket Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Textile Racket Detail Management API allows businesses to efficiently create and manage detailed information about textile rackets in their catalogs. This API facilitates the addition of new textile racket details, enabling users to enrich their product offerings with comprehensive specifications. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms, inventory management systems, and retail software solutions seeking to enhance their catalog data. By centralizing textile racket information, businesses can improve inventory accuracy and customer insights.

post.summary: Submit details for a textile racket.
post.description: This endpoint allows clients to submit specific details regarding a textile racket, facilitating the management and processing of textile-related requests. Ensure that all required fields are filled in the request body for successful submission.

requestBody.description: Request payload for creating or updating the details of a textile racket. This includes specifying various attributes related to the racket such as material, size, and design.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested details.

CreateCatalogTextileRacketDetailRequest.title: Textile Racket Order Request

textile_racket_id.description: The unique identifier for the textile racket.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the order.

quantity.description: The quantity of textile rackets being ordered.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the order is of priority status.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the textile racket.

CreateCatalogTextileRacketDetailRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for creating an order for a textile racket.

CreateCatalogTextileRacketDetailResponse.title: Textile Racket Details Response

status.description: The status of the operation, indicating whether it was successful or not.

recordId.description: The unique identifier for the record that was created or updated.

processedAt.description: The date and time when the operation was processed, formatted as an ISO 8601 string.

matchedCount.description: The number of records that matched the operation criteria.

CreateCatalogTextileRacketDetailResponse.description: Response schema for the successful operation of creating or updating textile racket details. It includes information about the status of the operation, the record identifier, the timestamp of processing, and the count of matched records.
